page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.large is a compute-optimized server belonging to the Enhanced instance family. It is built on KVM virtualization using x86_64 architecture and provides 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 4.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for compute-centric demands.

The hardware configuration omits local disk storage, meaning persistent storage must be provided via network-attached block storage volumes. Integrated GPU accelerators are absent from this instance type. Network specifications list a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

This resource profile prioritizes dedicated CPU access over memory density, offering a structured environment for tasks requiring steady compute capacity without heavy RAM overhead. Optimal workload deployment scenarios include entry-level web server hosting, internal microservices, software build pipelines, and automated batch processing tasks.
